authority: MIW-DERIVED topic structure, crosswalked to the official DGMA syllabus. The topic headings are not an official DGMA syllabus; official scope lives in docs/study/official_syllabus.json. See docs/study/SYLLABUS_SOURCE_STATUS.md.

official_syllabus.circular: DGMA EAC Branch Circular No.49 of 2026

domains.name: Statutory Framework, Survey & Classification
domains.rationale: Certificates, surveys, class and the flag/port State system that every other domain is enforced through.

largest_families: Entry into Force of an IMO Convention
IMO Structure and the Instrument Hierarchy
IMO Instruments Implementation Code - Objectives and Flag State Performance
Lubricating Oil Condition Analysis Techniques
Classification Requirements and Dual Class
Classification Societies in Rule Formation, and Survey Types
Enhanced Survey Programme versus Condition Assessment Programme
Formal Safety Assessment - Objectives, Characteristics and Process

domains.name: Marine Insurance & Commercial Law
domains.rationale: Liability, insurance and carriage of goods; presupposes the statutory status of the ship.

largest_families: Maritime Lien, In Rem and In Personam
Bunker Convention 2001 - Definitions and Comparison with CLC 92
General Average - Essential Features and a Refloating Claim
LLMC - Purpose, Heads of Claim and Legal Terms
Salvage Law and General Average
General Average - Essential Features and a Refloating Scenario
General Average - Principles and Contribution
P&I Clubs - Funding, Cover and Claims Handling

domains.name: Human Element, ISM & Management
domains.rationale: ISM/ISPS/MLC/STCW and shipboard management; the audit regime sits on the statutory certification regime.

largest_families: Human Element in STCW and IMO Fatigue Guidance
WHO, Disease Vectors and Ship Health Certificates
Audit versus Survey, and RO Action on ISM Certificates
Big Data in the Maritime Sector
Gender Equality and Diversity in the Maritime Industry
Gender Equality in Shipping
IMO and ILO Human Element Regimes, and Fatigue Guidance
Internet of Things in the Maritime Industry

domains.name: Pollution Prevention & Response
domains.rationale: MARPOL annexes, ORB, BWM, AFS and response.

largest_families: Anti-Fouling Convention and Alternatives to Tin-Based Paints
Casualty Investigation Code and VSMC
Bunker Convention 2001 Compared with CLC 92
Casualty Investigation - Obligation, Code and Very Serious Marine Casualty
Electronic Record Books under MARPOL
HNS Convention - Scope and Certification
Primary versus Secondary NOx Reduction, Scavenge Air Moisturizing and EGR
Root Cause Analysis, Active Failures and Latent Failures

domains.name: Alternative Fuels, GHG & Decarbonisation
domains.rationale: EEXI/CII/SEEMP, GFI and alternative fuels; the most currentness-sensitive domain in the corpus.

largest_families: Rudder Efficiency Improvement Devices
Ammonia as a Marine Fuel
CII - Concept, Commercial Impact and Shortcomings
CII Rating, AER and EEOI
Hull Form Optimisation for Energy Efficiency
Hull and Propeller Maintenance for Energy Efficiency
LNG Bunkering - Gassing Up, Cooldown, Vapour and Release
Life Cycle Analysis of Marine Fuels - WtW and WtT

domains.name: Indian Maritime Legislation
domains.rationale: Merchant Shipping Act and the Indian administration.

largest_families: Collision off the Indian Coast - Action under the Merchant Shipping Act
Hong Kong Convention and India's Ship Recycling Industry
UNCLOS Maritime Zones and a Missing Cadet in the EEZ
Unseaworthy and Unsafe Ships under the Merchant Shipping Act 1958
Unseaworthy and Unsafe Ships under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958

domains.name: Cargo Operations & Bulk Carriage
domains.rationale: IMSBC/IMDG/IGC, container and bulk cargo practice.

largest_families: FSA Applied to Lithium Batteries in Ro-Ro Carriage
Bauxite Casualties and Safe Carriage in Bulk
Carrier Responsibility under the Cargo Conventions, and Defences
Liquefaction of Solid Bulk Cargo

domains.name: Fire Safety, LSA & FSS
domains.rationale: SOLAS II-2 / III, FSS and LSA Codes -- Oral-heavy, and not a written primary_category in the solved corpus.

domains.name: Machinery, Electrical & Automation
domains.rationale: Engine room practice, automation and new engine technology -- Oral-heavy engineering practice.

domains.name: Ship Construction, Stability & Naval Architecture
domains.rationale: Stability criteria, structural members and hull form. Admitted as its own domain after review: the Oral corpus examines it heavily, no written primary_category names it, and folding it into D01 was polluting a statutory domain with naval architecture.
